public_instrument_sequence.effect: allotment authority, pre-emption disapplication, class redesignation, and rights instrument

date and quantity of any change recorded during the target period, to the extent recorded

deadline_contract.trigger: confirmed receipt of a compliant statutory request

evidence_ledger.venue: Companies House, Electric Twin statutory register, and any voluntarily supplied transaction instrument
evidence_ledger.target: source-addressable historical member entries and a transaction-specific bridge, not inferred allottee identity
evidence_ledger.upside: separates issuer action, registered title, and original subscription
evidence_ledger.downside: the statutory register may disclose only resulting legal title and may not state the acquisition mechanism
evidence_ledger.failure_mode: matching quantities, dates, or later registered positions are converted into allotment identity without an express transaction mechanism

prohibited_inferences: Do not infer allottee identity from numerical congruence between an SH01 quantity and a later registered holding.
Do not infer that the date entered as a member is an allotment date unless the source expressly states the mechanism.
Do not infer beneficial ownership, consideration source, settlement, nominee status, or transfer history from registered title alone.
Do not infer rights exercise, board nomination, observer status, consent activity, or shared governance participation from holder status or class rights.
Do not infer concealment, misconduct, invalidity, or absence of records from refusal, partial response, court application, routing failure, or silence.
Do not send, follow up, publish a nonresponse, or contact named individuals without separate authorization.
Do not change any canonical SH01 allottee field or create an actor hop from this prepared request.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A prepared and unsent statutory and first-party acquisition packet seeking narrow historical member entries and, separately, a transaction-specific allotment record.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A sent request, a finding that any named vehicle was an original allottee, evidence of beneficial ownership, a rights-exercise claim, or an actor-hop basis.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: This packet identifies official and first-party routes and prepares bounded request text. Requester identity and disclosure particulars are incomplete, dispatch is not authorized, no route has been executed, and every response state remains non-inferential until separately receipted and adjudicated.
